notes.title: New patch released!
notes.notes:
It's time to give a boost to your MXGP experience with this new super update full of improvements!

Race on the Lacapelle-Marival with Alessandro Lupino who is now part of the official MXGP21 roster, or enjoy a new bioma for the track editor!

We also added some nice touches like 30 sec extension to finish the line and much more!

But that's not all, check it out:

https://mxgpvideogame.com/game-updates/new-patch-released/

notes.title: New patch available!
notes.notes:
Hey riders, fantastic news for you! We have just released a super update full of improvements for MXGP 2021.

- Race on the Mantova track on all online and offline game modes.
- Explore the new Desert map on the Track Editor.
- Customize all the gameplay cameras.
- Upload your best Ghost on the leaderboards in Time Attack.

But that’s not all, check out the new patch!

https://mxgpvideogame.com/game-updates/new-patch-realesed-2/
